paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Paper presents updated stellar constraints on axion-electron coupling from tip of red-giant branch (TRGB) calibrations using geometric distance determinations. Primary result from NGC 4258 (cleanest extragalactic case): g_ae < 1.6×10^-13 at 95% CL. Secondary result from ω Centauri: g_ae < 1.3×10^-13 at 95% CL. The constraint is mass-independent (valid over wide mass range) as it derives from stellar cooling arguments. Encoded as horizontal line spanning 0 to 10^4 eV per standard protocol for mass-independent bounds. Paper also constrains neutrino dipole moments (μ_ν < 1.5×10^-12 μ_B from NGC 4258) but primary focus is axion-electron coupling.
